description: This header file defines comparison result types (`weak_equality`, `strong_equality`, `partial_ordering`, `weak_ordering`, `strong_ordering`) for three-way comparisons in the Abseil C++ library, compatible with C++11 and C++20 standards.

classes.name: weak_equality
classes.description: Represents the result of an equality comparison, with possible values 'equal' and 'nonequal'.

classes.name: strong_equality
classes.description: Represents the result of a strict equality comparison, with values 'equal', 'nonequal', 'equivalent', 'nonequivalent'.

classes.name: partial_ordering
classes.description: Represents the result of a partial order comparison, including ordered and unordered states.

classes.name: weak_ordering
classes.description: Represents the result of a weak ordering comparison, with 'less', 'equivalent', 'greater'.

classes.name: strong_ordering
classes.description: Represents the result of a strong ordering comparison, with 'less', 'equal', 'greater', 'equivalent'.
